visual.name: ganttChart
visual.description: A visually striking gantt chart designed to instantly convey your project.

dataRoles.name: ganttName
dataRoles.description: Dynamic variable for the Gantt title.

dataRoles.name: project
dataRoles.description: Project identifier used to group activities and scope phase zones.

dataRoles.name: id
dataRoles.description: Unique identifier for each task.

dataRoles.name: activity
dataRoles.description: The name of the task or milestone.

dataRoles.name: activityType
dataRoles.description: Type of activity (e.g., 'task', 'milestone', 'project').

dataRoles.name: startDate
dataRoles.description: The current start date of the activity.

dataRoles.name: endDate
dataRoles.description: The current end date of the activity.

dataRoles.name: days
dataRoles.description: The current duration in days.

dataRoles.name: completion
dataRoles.description: Percentage of task completion (e.g., 0.5 for 50%).

dataRoles.name: owner
dataRoles.description: The owner of the activity.

dataRoles.name: status
dataRoles.description: The current status of the task.

dataRoles.name: priority
dataRoles.description: The priority of the task.

dataRoles.name: effort
dataRoles.description: The current effort in hours.

dataRoles.name: dependencies
dataRoles.description: Comma-separated list of IDs this task depends on.

dataRoles.name: phaseTag
dataRoles.description: Phase name per activity. The visual derives each phase's start (min) and end (max) from its activities, per project.

dataRoles.name: reportDate
dataRoles.description: A specific date to be used by the reference line.

dataRoles.name: tooltipData
dataRoles.description: Drag fields here to show in tooltip

dataRoles.name: startPlan
dataRoles.description: The planned start date for baseline.

dataRoles.name: endPlan
dataRoles.description: The planned end date for baseline.

dataRoles.name: daysPlan
dataRoles.description: The planned duration in days.

dataRoles.name: effortPlan
dataRoles.description: The planned effort in hours.

startPositionOffset.description: Deslocamento vertical (em pixels) para o início da linha. Padrão: 0.
